{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crosstown Line''' was a mass transit [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] that crossed through [[Estalle Island]]. It was elevated, and connected with the [[Coast Line]] that encircled the island.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
